manifest.name: dsh-chat-image-lightbox
manifest.description: 对话里的图值得被认真看：点一下全屏灯箱（缩放/拖拽平移/下载另存/左右翻页），一键把会话内的图收成可调列数的缩略图网格，或整块隐藏（不留空白）；本地图 TIFF/HEIC 自动无损转码，网图被防盗链拦截时自动转存本地显示；并内置「图片投递铁律」——强制图片写进回复正文而不是只躺在折叠的工具行里，避免用户误以为没发图。| Chat images get a proper look: full-screen lightbox (zoom / drag pan / download / prev-next), a conversation-wide thumbnail grid with adjustable columns, hide/show without leaving blank space, lossless TIFF/HEIC transcoding, and automatic local fallback for hotlink-protected images — plus a resident delivery rule that forces every image into the reply body instead of a collapsed tool row, so nobody ever wonders whether an image was actually sent.

readme.section: DSH Chat Image Lightbox 🖼
readme.text:
> ### 🛡 v1.8.9 — 工具行折叠 ≠ 已发送：铁律升级为「必须复述 + 计数自检」 / Collapsed tool row ≠ delivered
>
> **实测事故（2026-10-21）**：插件 20 张图（10 种格式）全部交付成功，但模型把图全留在 `display_image` 的工具结果里，
> 正文只写了一张格式对照表 → 用户回「一张没看见啊」。原因是 1.7.8~1.8.8 的铁律只写了「不得只依赖工具行」，
> 可以被「正文写了字但没写图」绕过。
>
> 1.8.9 起铁律升级为 6 条硬约束 + 1 条收尾自检：**必须把工具返回的 `` 原样复述进正文**、
> **表格/结论/清单都不算图**、**发前数一遍正文里 ` · 排查见 [⑥ 发图失败](#发图片时提示-sessionagent-busy-errdlopenfailed175-已修复) 与 [Troubleshooting ⑥](#sending-an-image-fails-with-sessionagent-busy-errdlopenfailed-fixed-in-175)。
>
> **If sending an image fails** with those errors (plain text works fine), it is a known issue in **1.7.4 and earlier**, **fixed in 1.7.5**. Upgrade and restart DSH. Cause: the old version pinned `sharp` to `0.34.4`, conflicting with the kernel's `^0.35.3` over the same-named `libvips-42.dll`.

readme.section: English
readme.text:
A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that displays images inline in the chat with a lightbox overlay — zoom, download (save-as dialog), and prev/next navigation.

Pictures from your agent sit tiny inside a bubble — to see detail you have to save them and open elsewhere. With this plugin, **one click opens any chat image full-screen**: zoom, drag-pan, download, and flip through the others in the same message.

readme.section: Features
readme.text:
- **Inline display**: Images in AI responses render directly in the chat (via markdown ``)
- **Click to zoom**: Click any image to open a full-screen lightbox; clicking the enlarged image zooms in again, and clicking while already zoomed **closes** the lightbox (the zoomed image covers the backdrop, so this guarantees the close target is reachable). `Esc` or clicking the backdrop also closes it.
- **Scroll to zoom & pan**: When zoomed in, use the mouse wheel to zoom further and drag to pan around the image
- **Download**: Click the download button ⬇ to save the image (triggers browser save-as dialog for same-origin images; filename is sanitized and the extension is derived from the image type)
- **Navigation**: Left/right arrow buttons, keyboard arrows, or swipe left/right on touch devices to switch between multiple images
- **Caption**: The viewer shows the current image's filename/caption
- **Accessible**: The lightbox is a proper `role="dialog"` with `aria-modal`, button `aria-label`s, and focus management (focus returns to the trigger on close)
- **Smooth**: Adjacent images are prefetched so navigation feels instant
- **Close**: Click backdrop, press Escape, or click ✕ to close

readme.section: Method 1: npm (recommended)
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-chat-image-lightbox
```

readme.section: Method 2: Manual
readme.text:
1. Copy the `lib/` folder and `cordis.patch.yml` to your DSH profile's `node_modules/dsh-chat-image-lightbox/`
2. Add `dsh-chat-image-lightbox` to your profile's `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles` array
3. Restart DSH Desktop

readme.section: Usage
readme.text:
1. Place images in `~/.dsh/uploads/` (or any directory served by your DSH instance)
2. Call the `display_image` tool and **paste the markdown it returns straight into your reply body** (this step is not optional — tool rows are collapsed):
   ```
   ![图1][2ab1]

[2ab1]: C:/Users/me/pic.jpg
   ```
   That is the real 1.8.x shape: **reference-style + absolute local path**, which the Host rewrites into `api/file?path=…`.
3. The image will display inline with lightbox enhancement

readme.section: Usage
readme.text: > ⚠️ **Do not hand-build `/images/?abs=…`.** That is the legacy 1.7.x shape. On Desktop (page origin `dsh-app://app`) > `parseFileLink` returns `undefined` for any destination containing `?`, and `localPathMediaUrl` strips `?abs=` via > `split(/[?#]/)`, leaving `dsh-app://app/api/file?path=%2Fimages%2F` — a *directory* — which answers > `FS_NOT_REGULAR_FILE` + 403 and renders as "failed · filename". The body builder shipped in 1.7.9 on GitHub uses > exactly that shape, **which is why it renders nothing on Desktop — do not treat it as a reference implementation**. > > ⚠️ **Never use `http://127.0.0.1:/images/...` either.** DSH Desktop renders the GUI inside the custom protocol > `dsh-app://app`, so the loopback `http://` origin is a *different* origin: Chromium blocks it in the renderer before the > request ever reaches the web server (`fetch` throws `TypeError: Failed to fetch`, `` fires `onerror`).

readme.section: Usage
readme.text: **Note**: For the download button to trigger a save-as dialog, the image must be served from the same origin as your DSH instance (e.g., via the `/images/` route). Cross-origin images will open in a new tab instead.

readme.section: Troubleshooting image display (important)
readme.text: When an image shows as blank, a blob of text, or the lightbox opens empty, check in this order:

readme.section: ① Images must use an http(s) URL or a root-relative path — base64/data-URI and attachments are NOT rendered
readme.text: DSH renders images into `` from an http(s) URL **or an absolute local path written in markdown**. It does **not** render `data:image/png;base64,...` inline, nor "file-delivery/attachment" messages (those appear as tool-call text, not an image). - ✅ Correct — verbatim `display_image` output (reference-style + absolute local path; the Host rewrites it into `api/file?path=…`): ``` ![图1][2ab1] [2ab1]: C:/Users/me/pic.jpg ``` - ✅ Correct — any non-hotlink-protected external image: ```

readme.section: ① Images must use an http(s) URL or a root-relative path — base64/data-URI and attachments are NOT rendered
readme.text:
```
- ❌ Will NOT render — absolute loopback URL (blocked cross-origin under `dsh-app://app`):
  ```

```
- ❌ Will NOT render — base64 inline:
  ```

```

readme.section: ② Blank image / empty lightbox = hotlink protection on the image host (source limit, not this plugin)
readme.text: Some hosts (e.g. **Sina Weibo sinaimg**, some CDNs) enforce `Referer`-checking: a request without the expected `Referer` returns 403, so the image frame renders but no pixels load (clicking still opens the lightbox, but there is no image).

readme.section: ② Blank image / empty lightbox = hotlink protection on the image host (source limit, not this plugin)
readme.text:
- No normal webpage can hotlink these directly (including all sites except Weibo) — this is not something any plugin can fix.
- **Workaround**: download the image to `~/.dsh/uploads/` (fetch with a proper `Referer`, or just save it from the browser), then serve it via `/images/`.

Example — fetching a hotlink-protected image (Windows):
```
curl -e "https://weibo.com" -o image.jpg "https://wx1.sinaimg.cn/.../xxx.jpg"
```

readme.section: ③ Supported image formats
readme.text:
| Format | Displayed | Notes |
|--------|-----------|-------|
| jpg / jpeg / png / gif / webp / bmp / svg / ico / avif | ✅ Directly | Mainstream formats — display + lightbox work, bytes untouched |
| **tiff / tif** | ✅ Via server conversion | Browsers can't render TIFF; the plugin server converts it to WebP at full original resolution (bundled `sharp`) — HD display, and download keeps the original `.tif` |
| **heic** | ✅ Via server conversion | Same as TIFF — displayed as WebP, downloaded as the original `.heic` |

readme.section: ③ Supported image formats
readme.text: Files go in `~/.dsh/uploads/` and display via `/images/` — no manual conversion needed.

readme.section: ④ Plugin not working after changes — restart fully
readme.text: After installing or editing plugin files, **fully quit all DSH Desktop processes** (Task Manager → end every `DSH Desktop.exe`) and reopen. Closing just the window does not quit (background processes stay). Old/unloaded code keeps the plugin inactive otherwise.

readme.section: ⑤ Is it actually the plugin? Quick checklist
readme.text:
- Test with a `/images/`-served upload — if it displays and lightboxes, the plugin is fine.
- Test with a non-hotlink-host image (e.g. `https://picsum.photos/800/600`) — if that works, the plugin is generic.
- If neither uploads nor external images lightbox → the plugin client didn't load, usually because DSH wasn't fully restarted or the install is incomplete.

readme.section: ⑥ Sending an image fails with `session/agent-busy` / `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED` (fixed in 1.7.5)
readme.text:
If **sending an image** fails with:

```
prompt rejected: Could not load the "sharp" module using the win32-x64 runtime
ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED: The specified procedure could not be found.
(session/agent-busy)
```

this is a known issue in **1.7.4 and earlier**, **fixed in 1.7.5**. Just upgrade:

```
pnpm add dsh-chat-image-lightbox@latest
```

readme.section: ⑥ Sending an image fails with `session/agent-busy` / `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED` (fixed in 1.7.5)
readme.text: **Why it happened**: the DSH kernel ships `sharp ^0.35.3`, while older versions of this plugin **pinned sharp to exactly `0.34.4`** — putting two different sharp builds into one process. They load a DLL with the **same filename** (`libvips-42.dll`) but need different companions (`libvips-cpp-8.17.2.dll` for 0.34.x vs `libvips-cpp-8.18.3.dll` for 0.35.x). **Windows resolves DLLs by filename**, so whichever loads first claims the name and the other fails with "the specified procedure could not be found".

readme.section: ⑥ Sending an image fails with `session/agent-busy` / `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED` (fixed in 1.7.5)
readme.text:
The trailing `agent-busy` is a generic wrapper the kernel applies to **unclassified errors** — it has nothing to do with actual concurrency, which is why the real cause is hard to spot from the message alone.

> Note: this only ever affected **sending images**; plain text chat was never impacted.

readme.section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order
readme.text:
This section is for "plugin just installed, everything looks fine, but when the assistant sends images the message body has none". Go in order — whichever one hits tells you where the problem is.

**1. Check the three host startup log lines** (`~/.dsh/logs/desktop-next.log`):

readme.section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order
readme.text:
| Log line | What its absence means |
|---|---|
| `image-gallery: serving from ... (sharp: available)` | The plugin is not loaded at all (see item 3) |
| `image-gallery: image delivery law registered (order 1500, ... chars)` | The `systemPrompt` service is unavailable → the plugin warns `delivery law skipped`. **The delivery law is then not in the system prompt, so the model will likely leave images in the tool row where you cannot see them** |
| `image-gallery: display_image tool registered` | The `tools` service or `defineTool` is unavailable → the plugin warns `display_image tool skipped`. **There is no tool to call** |

readme.section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order
readme.text: **2. `(sharp: unavailable)` is not the cause of "no images".** It only affects TIFF/HEIC (they render as "image cannot be previewed"); JPG/PNG/WEBP are fine. Root cause: after a junction install, Node resolves from the plugin's real path and cannot find `profiles/<name>/node_modules` (where sharp lives — a sibling branch, not an ancestor). The plugin already resolves against multiple roots as a fallback.

readme.section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order
⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order
readme.text: With only the first two, **the host skips the package silently: no warning, no error, the plugin behaves as if it does not exist**. Check with `Test-Path <profile>/node_modules/dsh-chat-image-lightbox`.

readme.section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order
readme.text: **4. After changing client code, fully exit the process before restarting.** With `closeToTray: true`, clicking the window's × only hides it to the system tray — the process keeps running, and host plugins load at boot with no hot reload, so this is not a restart. `Ctrl+R` does not reload client bundles either. Correct way: tray icon → right click → Quit, wait for the process to disappear, then start again.

readme.section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order
readme.text: **5. Do not chase `dsh.client.inject`.** A wrong package name there is **silently ignored** (the host simply does not schedule an `inject` entry it cannot resolve, and reports nothing); only `external` fails hard. So a bad `inject` entry cannot cause "no images".

readme.section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order
readme.text: **6. A 403 `Browser access is disabled` from a plain browser or curl on `/images/?abs=...` is expected.** The desktop app defaults to `browserAccess: false` and only admits requests carrying the Electron renderer token. Viewing images inside the desktop client is unaffected.

readme.section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order
readme.text: > **The most important point**: if everything above is green and all three log lines are present, yet the assistant's message body still has only text — **that is not a plugin fault, it is the model not following the image delivery law**. DSH's host only auto-promotes results of the built-in `read_image` tool (source: `imageCardModel` contains `if (call?.name !== "read_image") return null;`); results from third-party tools always fold into the tool row, and the tool row is **collapsed by default**. So a third-party plugin can only deliver images by **writing the markdown image into the reply body**. That constraint is enforced by the system-prompt section the plugin registers — if that log line is missing, the constraint is not there.

readme.section: Keyboard & Mouse
readme.text:
| Action | Input |
|--------|-------|
| Open lightbox | Click an image |
| Zoom in / out | Click image, or mouse wheel when zoomed |
| Pan | Drag the image while zoomed |
| Prev / next | `←` / `→` keys, on-screen arrows, or swipe |
| Close | `Esc`, click backdrop, or ✕ |

readme.section: HTTP API
readme.text:
| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/images/<path>` | GET | Serve an uploaded image (loopback-only, with extension/security guards) |
| `/api/image-gallery/list` | GET | List images under the gallery root; supports `?limit=N` |
| `/api/image-gallery/root` | GET | Return the configured gallery root path |
| `/api/image-gallery/reveal` | POST | Reveal a file in the OS file manager (Explorer / Finder) |
| `/api/image-gallery/diag` | POST | Append a line to `~/.dsh/image-gallery-diag.log` (client-side debug sink; no-op unless `IG_DEBUG` is on) |

readme.section: How It Works
readme.text: | Component | Description | |-----------|-------------| | **Host** (`lib/index.js`) | Registers `/images/` file-serving route plus 4 `/api/image-gallery/*` exact routes (`list`, `root`, `reveal`, `diag`) on `ctx.webServer` | | **Client** (`lib/client.js`) | Uses `MutationObserver` to watch for `` elements in the chat, adds a display class + click handlers that open a lightbox overlay (class-only enhancement, no DOM restructuring) |

readme.section: Requirements
readme.text:
- **DSH kernel** — the package declares `engines.dsh: ">=0.1.7-0 <0.3.0"` (and the same range in `peerDependencies`). The upper bound is deliberate: `peerDependencies` is a **runtime gate** — the host checks it before importing the plugin and silently disables the row on mismatch, so an open-ended range would let a future breaking generation install "successfully" and then fail quietly. This release was verified end to end on **DSH NEXT 2.0.19-next** (kernel `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.2.1-rc.2`). The client half relies on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-tool` being injectable (measured `0.2.1-rc.2`).
- Host must expose the `webServer` service (standard in DSH Desktop).
- Node.js ≥ 22
- `sharp` `^0.35.3` (declared as a dependency; it is what performs the lossless TIFF/HEIC transcoding). The range follows the DSH kernel's own `^0.35.3` — an exact pin here would put two different sharp builds into one process and break image sending (see Troubleshooting).
- **Windows note**: "show in folder" uses `explorer /select,`

readme.section: 中文
readme.text: [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件：在对话框中直接显示图片，支持放大、下载（弹出另存为）、左右切换。

readme.section: 功能
readme.text:
- **内联显示**：AI 回复中的图片直接在对话框渲染（通过 markdown ``） - **点击放大**：点击任意图片打开全屏 lightbox；在原始比例下点图会放大到 1.6 倍，**已放大时再点一下则关闭灯箱**（放大的图会盖住背景，这样保证点得到关闭目标）。`Esc` 或点击背景同样可关闭。 - **滚轮缩放 + 拖拽平移**：放大后可用鼠标滚轮继续缩放，按住拖拽平移查看细节 - **下载**：点击下载按钮 ⬇ 保存图片（同源图片弹出"另存为"对话框；文件名会清洗，扩展名按图片类型自动补全） - **切换**：左右箭头按钮、键盘方向键，或在触屏上左右滑动切换多张图片 - **文件名**：查看器底部显示当前图片的文件名/标题 - **无障碍**：lightbox 是标准的 `role="dialog"`（含 `aria-modal`、按钮 `aria-label` 与焦点管理，关闭后焦点回到触发元素） - **预取**：自动预取相邻图片，切换更顺滑 - **关闭**：点击遮罩层、按 Esc 或点 ✕ 关闭 - **ZCode 式渲染**：聊天图片原地加样式——**绝不搬移、改父级或重排 DOM 节点**，不与 DSH 的 React 虚拟列表打架（不再出现图片消失/重复、控制台 `removeChild` 报错） - **限高不裁剪**：每张聊天图保持原始纵横比，高度封顶 `min(460px, 64vh)`（ZCode 的观感）；图表、流程图不再被裁得没法看 - **TIFF/HEIC 直显**：浏览器原生不渲染 TIFF——插件服务端用内置 sharp 将 TIFF/HEIC **按原始分辨率**即时转 WebP 显示（本地图表导出照样高清直显），下载按钮保存的仍是原始 `.tif`/`.heic` 文件 - **多图九宫格**：一条消息里有多张图时自动排成整齐网格（约 3 列），文字段落横跨整行排在网格上方——纯 CSS（`display:contents`），不搬任何节点。**1.9.1 起：只有「容器里全是图片」才会走网格**，混合图文（图片 + 表格/散文）一律不进网格，不再出现「自动变 4 列 + 表格被塞进图片行之间」 - **同排瓦片严格齐平（1.9.3）**：承载缩略图的 `

` 会加 `.dsh-ig-tileline` 把 margin/padding/border/line-height/font-size/min-height 全部归零，让它**不拥有行盒**——修掉「第一张图比同排其他图高 20px」 - **点开即高清**：点击任意图片打开 lightbox 看全分辨率大图，放大看到每个像素；下载永远保存原始文件 - **界面干净**：lightbox 的工具按钮（下载/关闭）、左右切换箭头、计数、标题在 li

readme.section: 方式一：npm（推荐）
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-chat-image-lightbox
```

readme.section: 方式二：手动安装
readme.text:
1. 把 `lib/` 文件夹和 `cordis.patch.yml` 复制到 DSH profile 的 `node_modules/dsh-chat-image-lightbox/`
2. 在 profile 的 `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组中添加 `dsh-chat-image-lightbox`
3. 重启 DSH Desktop

readme.section: 使用方法
readme.text:
1. 把图片放到 `~/.dsh/uploads/` 目录（或 DSH 实例提供的任意目录）
2. 直接调 `display_image` 工具，**把它返回的 markdown 原样贴进回复正文**（这一步不能省，工具行是折叠的）：
   ```
   ![图1][2ab1]

[2ab1]: C:/Users/me/pic.jpg
   ```
   这是 1.8.x 的真实形态：**引用式 + 本机绝对路径**，由宿主改写成 `api/file?path=…` 直出。
3. 图片会内联显示并自动带 lightbox 增强

readme.section: 使用方法
readme.text: > ⚠️ **不要自己拼 `/images/?abs=…`**。那是 1.7.x 的旧形态，在桌面端（页面源 `dsh-app://app`）会被 > `parseFileLink`（遇到 `?` 直接返回 `undefined`）与 `localPathMediaUrl`（`split(/[?#]/)` 剥掉 `?abs=`）联手打碎成 > `dsh-app://app/api/file?path=%2Fimages%2F` —— 一个目录，`/api/file` 回 `FS_NOT_REGULAR_FILE` + 403，界面显示「失败 · 文件名」。 > GitHub 上 1.7.9 的正文拼装就是这个写法，**所以它在桌面端根本不出图，不要当参考实现**。 > > ⚠️ **也不要用 `http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/images/...`。** 桌面端页面源是 `dsh-app://app`，`http://` 回环对页面而言是 > **另一个源**，Chromium 在渲染进程里直接拦掉，请求根本到不了 webServer（`fetch` 抛 `TypeError: Failed to fetch`， > `` 触发 `onerror`，服务端命中 0）。

readme.section: 使用方法
readme.text: **注意**：下载按钮要弹出"另存为"对话框，图片必须从 DSH 同源路由提供（如 `/images/` 路由）。跨域图片会在新标签页打开。

readme.section: 图片显示常见问题排查（重要）
readme.text: 遇到"图片显示不出来 / 点开是空白 / 只看到一串文字"时，按以下顺序排查：

readme.section: ① 图片必须用 http(s) 外链或站内根相对路径，不能依赖 base64 或附件
readme.text: DSH 对话只对 **http(s) 图片 URL** 或 **markdown 里的本机绝对路径**渲染成 ``，**不支持 `data:image/png;base64,...` 内嵌**，也不支持以"附件/文件交付"方式直接显示（那只会显示成工具调用文字）。 - ✅ 正确：**原样粘贴 `display_image` 的输出**（引用式 + 本机绝对路径，宿主会改写成 `api/file?path=…`） ``` ![图1][2ab1] [2ab1]: C:/Users/me/pic.jpg ``` - ✅ 正确：任意**无防盗链**的外链图片 ``` ``` - ❌ 错误：回环绝对地址（`dsh-app://app` 下跨源被拦，永远加载不出） ``` ``` - ❌ 错误：base64 内嵌（DSH 渲染不出，只看到一串 `iVBORw0...`） ``` ← 不会显示 ```

readme.section: ② 图片空白 / 点开灯箱没图案 = 图源防盗链（图床限制，非插件问题）
readme.text: 部分图床（如**新浪微博 sinaimg、部分 CDN**）强制 `Referer` 校验：请求不带特定 `Referer` 就返回 403，导致图片加载不出（有 `` 框但内容空白，点击能弹灯箱但没图）。 - 这类图**任何普通网页都无法直接外链显示**（包括微博自己以外的所有站点），不是本插件能解决的。 - **解决办法**：把图下载到本地 `~/.dsh/uploads/`（可用带 `Referer` 的脚本抓取，或直接用浏览器保存），再通过 `/images/` 路由显示。 示例：抓取带防盗链的图（Windows 下用带 Referer 的 curl 或脚本下载后放入 uploads）： ``` curl -e "https://weibo.com" -o 图.jpg "https://wx1.sinaimg.cn/.../xxx.jpg" ```

readme.section: ③ 支持哪些图片格式
readme.text:
| 格式 | 显示 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| jpg / jpeg / png / gif / webp / bmp / svg / ico / avif | ✅ 直接显示 | 主流格式，直接显示 + 灯箱，字节原样不动 |
| **tiff / tif** | ✅ 服务端转码显示 | 浏览器不能渲染 TIFF，插件服务端用内置 sharp 按原始分辨率转 WebP 显示——高清直显，下载仍是原始 `.tif` 文件 |
| **heic** | ✅ 服务端转码显示 | 同 TIFF——显示为 WebP，下载保存原始 `.heic` |

图片放到 `~/.dsh/uploads/`，用 `/images/` 显示——无需手工转码。

readme.section: ④ 彻底重启后插件不生效
readme.text: 改过插件文件或刚安装后，必须**彻底退出 DSH 进程再重开**（任务管理器结束所有 `DSH Desktop.exe` 进程），否则旧代码/未加载状态不生效。仅"关闭窗口"不算退出（后台进程残留）。

readme.section: ⑤ 判断是不是插件问题的清单
readme.text:
- 用 `/images/` 上传图测：如果上传图正常显示 + 灯箱，说明插件正常
- 换无防盗链图床（如 picsum.photos）的图测：正常则插件通用
- 若上传图、外链图都不亮灯箱 → 插件 client 未加载，多半是没彻底重启或没装正确

readme.section: ⑥ 发图片时提示 `session/agent-busy` / `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED`（1.7.5 已修复）
readme.text:
如果**发图片**时报错：

```
prompt rejected: Could not load the "sharp" module using the win32-x64 runtime
ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED: The specified procedure could not be found.
(session/agent-busy)
```

这是 **1.7.4 及更早版本**的已知问题，**1.7.5 已修复**。升级即可：

```
pnpm add dsh-chat-image-lightbox@latest
```

readme.section: ⑥ 发图片时提示 `session/agent-busy` / `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED`（1.7.5 已修复）
readme.text:
**为什么会这样**：DSH 内核自带 `sharp ^0.35.3`，而旧版本把本插件的 sharp **精确锁定在 0.34.4**，于是同一个进程里出现了两个不同版本的 sharp。它们加载的 DLL **同名**（都叫 `libvips-42.dll`），但各自需要不同的配套文件（0.34.x 要 `libvips-cpp-8.17.2.dll`，0.35.x 要 `libvips-cpp-8.18.3.dll`）。**Windows 按文件名解析 DLL**——谁先加载谁占住，后来者就报"找不到指定的过程"。

报错末尾的 `agent-busy`（会话忙）是 DSH 对**无法分类的错误**套用的通用标签，与实际是否繁忙无关，因此很难一眼看出真因。

> 注：此问题只影响**发图片**，纯文字对话始终正常。

readme.section: ⑦ 装了插件还是看不到图？按这个顺序查（安装侧排查）
readme.text:
这一条专门给「刚装好插件、功能看起来正常、但让 AI 发图时正文里就是没有图」的情况。按顺序查，命中哪条就说明问题在哪：

**1. 先看宿主启动日志里这三条是否齐全**（`~/.dsh/logs/desktop-next.log`）：

readme.section: ⑦ 装了插件还是看不到图？按这个顺序查（安装侧排查）
readme.text:
| 日志行 | 缺了说明什么 |
|---|---|
| `image-gallery: serving from ... (sharp: available)` | 插件没装载（看下面第 3 条） |
| `image-gallery: image delivery law registered (order 1500, ... chars)` | `systemPrompt` 服务不可用 → 插件会 warn `delivery law skipped`。**这时铁律没进 system prompt，模型很可能只在工具行里出图，你就看不到** |
| `image-gallery: display_image tool registered` | `tools` 服务或 `defineTool` 不可用 → 插件会 warn `display_image tool skipped`。**这时根本没有工具可调** |

readme.section: ⑦ 装了插件还是看不到图？按这个顺序查（安装侧排查）
readme.text:
**2. `(sharp: unavailable)` 不是「看不到图」的原因。** 它只影响 TIFF/HEIC（会显示成「图片无法预览」），JPG/PNG/WEBP 照常。根因是 junction 安装后 Node 从插件真实路径向上找不到 `profiles/<name>/node_modules`（sharp 在那里，是兄弟分支不是祖先）；插件已用多根解析兜底。

**3. 确认插件真的挂上了（只做前两件等于没挂）。** 三件事必须同时成立：
   - `<profile>/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里有这个包（本地安装写 `"link:<插件绝对路径>"`）；
   - 同文件 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里有包名；
   - `<profile>/node_modules/<包名>` 存在（Junction 或实体目录）。

readme.section: ⑦ 装了插件还是看不到图？按这个顺序查（安装侧排查）
readme.text:
只有前两件、没有第三件时，**宿主会静默跳过，日志里既不 warn 也不 error，插件像不存在**。判别：`Test-Path <profile>/node_modules/dsh-chat-image-lightbox`。

**4. 改了客户端代码必须「完全退出进程」再启动。** `closeToTray: true` 时点窗口右上角 × 只是收进系统托盘，进程并不退出，宿主插件是 boot 装载不热重载 → 等于没重启。`Ctrl+R` 刷新页面也不重载客户端 bundle。正解：托盘图标右键 → 退出，等进程消失后再启动。

**5. 不要往 `dsh.client.inject` 方向排查。** 里面写错包名是**静默无效**的（宿主对 inject 里查不到的包只是不排队，不报错）；只有 `external` 写错才会硬失败。所以 inject 写错不会导致「不显示」。

readme.section: ⑦ 装了插件还是看不到图？按这个顺序查（安装侧排查）
readme.text:
**6. 用浏览器或 curl 直接访问 `/images/?abs=...` 拿到 403 `Browser access is disabled`，这是预期行为。** 桌面端默认 `browserAccess: false`，只放行带 Electron 渲染器令牌的请求。你在桌面客户端界面里看图不受影响。

> **最重要的一条**：如果以上全绿、日志三条齐全，但 AI 发图时正文里仍然只有文字——那**不是插件故障**，是 AI 没遵守「图片投递铁律」。DSH 宿主只给内置的 `read_image` 工具自动出图（源码里 `imageCardModel` 有 `if (call?.name !== "read_image") return null;` 的白名单），第三方工具的结果一律被折进工具行，而工具行**默认是收起的**。所以第三方插件发图，**只能靠把 markdown 图片写进回复正文**。这条约束由插件注册的 system prompt 段强制执行；若那条日志缺失，约束就不在。

readme.section: 键盘与鼠标
readme.text:
| 操作 | 输入 |
|------|------|
| 打开 lightbox | 点击图片 |
| 放大 / 缩小 | 点击图片，或放大后滚动滚轮 |
| 平移 | 放大后按住拖拽 |
| 上一张 / 下一张 | `←` / `→` 方向键、屏幕箭头、或滑动 |
| 关闭 | `Esc`、点击遮罩层、或 ✕ |

readme.section: HTTP 接口
readme.text:
| 接口 | 方法 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `/images/<path>` | GET | 提供上传图片（仅本机回环，带扩展名/安全校验） |
| `/api/image-gallery/list` | GET | 列出图库根目录下图片，支持 `?limit=N` |
| `/api/image-gallery/root` | GET | 返回配置的图库根目录路径 |
| `/api/image-gallery/reveal` | POST | 在系统文件管理器（资源管理器 / Finder）中定位并选中某个文件 |
| `/api/image-gallery/diag` | POST | 向 `~/.dsh/image-gallery-diag.log` 追加一行（客户端调试通道；`IG_DEBUG` 关闭时无实际写入） |

readme.section: 工作原理
readme.text: | 组件 | 说明 | |------|------| | **Host** (`lib/index.js`) | 在 `ctx.webServer` 上注册 `/images/` 文件服务路由 + 4 条 `/api/image-gallery/*` 精确路由（`list`、`root`、`reveal`、`diag`） | | **Client** (`lib/client.js`) | 用 `MutationObserver` 监听对话中的 `` 元素，添加展示样式与点击处理器打开 lightbox（只加 class，不改 DOM 结构） |

readme.section: 环境要求
readme.text:
- **DSH 内核** —— 本包声明 `engines.dsh: ">=0.1.7-0 <0.3.0"`（`peerDependencies` 同区间）。上界是刻意的：`peerDependencies` 是**运行时门禁**——宿主在 import 插件**之前**校验，不匹配就直接禁用该行且模块永不导入，所以开区间上界会让将来某个破坏性世代「装上看似正常、然后静默失效」。本版实测验证于 **DSH NEXT 2.0.19-next**（内核 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.2.1-rc.2`）。浏览器端依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-tool` 可被注入（实测 `0.2.1-rc.2`）。
- 宿主需提供 `webServer` 服务（DSH 桌面端标准配置）。
- Node.js ≥ 22
- `sharp` `^0.35.3`（已声明为依赖，TIFF/HEIC 的无损转码由它完成）。采用区间跟随 DSH 内核自身的 `^0.35.3`——若在此精确锁版，会让两个不同 sharp 版本共存于同一进程，导致**发图失败**（见「图片显示常见问题排查」）。
- **Windows 说明**：「在文件夹中显示」使用 `explorer /select,`

readme.section: 许可证
readme.text: MIT
